sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: You've got to be kidding me. Today of all days?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels openly exasperated and panicked at the bad timing, with a frustrated disbelief that her already stressful first day is getting even worse.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, okay. Don't panic. Fast walk, transfer, survive.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to steady herself with brisk, self-motivating determination, masking rising stress and urgency with a practical pep talk.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.text: Made it! Barely! I am never trusting that line again.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless relief and triumphant frustration at having arrived at all, with a lingering vow to avoid that train line after such a stressful start.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Year one, class three... end of the hall, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is tense and hurried but trying to stay upbeat and focused, mentally checking directions while pushing past her embarrassment about being late.
sprite_sequence.label: determined

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and breathless from rushing in late, but still upbeat and determined to make a cheerful first impression despite her embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a burst of embarrassed panic that instantly flips into playful self-deprecation, trying to cover her mistake with upbeat humor and keep her confidence intact.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to laugh off her blunder with self-deprecating humor to recover her composure.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: What kind of map prints north in six-point font?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and embarrassed, but mostly venting frustrated disbelief at the absurdity of the mistake while trying to laugh it off.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... please let the teacher be nice.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and anxious after a string of humiliating mistakes, but still pushing herself forward with hopeful, pleading determination that the teacher will be forgiving.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Please tell me you're also in 1-3 and not judging me too hard.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but is trying to recover with humor and hopeful friendliness, quietly desperate for reassurance that she hasn’t completely blown her first impression.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Then lead the way, hero. I'll owe you my life for at least one lunch break.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and amused, quickly shifting into playful gratitude and friendly trust as she lets the other girl take charge.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered but relieved to have finally arrived at the right classroom, and she’s trying to recover with upbeat, socially confident energy despite the embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and sheepish, but also relieved that the teacher is taking it lightly and trying to recover with a self-conscious joke.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Thank you! I swear this is not my usual brand.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and embarrassed at once, trying to laugh off her disastrous first impression while reassuring everyone that she’s usually much more put-together.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. New term status: messy start, but not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish but relieved, trying to laugh off the chaos and regain her confidence now that the worst seems to be over.
sprite_sequence.label: smile
